Due to the way geek ratings are calculated (BoardGameGeek FAQ | Wiki | BoardGameGeek; <-look under What is the difference between BGG rating and User Rating), I reckon that it'll be better to have a large number of raters on 1 entry rather than half the raters on 1 entry and half on the other. Again, lots of assumptions here but I feel that it is better to have just 1 BGG entry.

Are people going to ask about the (H) questions in the 2nd ed forum and other generic questions in the 1st ed forum?
